Friendzy / Classic party games / The Drama Sentence

How to play The Drama Sentence

One sentence. Infinite emotions. Someone gives you a perfectly mundane sentence. You must deliver it with extreme emotion — crying, furious, deeply in love, terrified. The sentence never changes, only the delivery.

2–10 players~8 minDramatic & HilariousActing & performance games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Group picks a boring sentence. Example: 'The soup is ready.'
  2. One player is assigned an extreme emotion by the group.
  3. They deliver the sentence with that emotion as dramatically as possible.
  4. Group votes on the best performance.
  5. Rotate — new sentence, new emotion, new player.

Example round

  • Sentence: 'I'm just going to get some water.' Emotion: Devastating heartbreak. → Pure Oscar material.
  • Sentence: 'The Wi-Fi password is written on the fridge.' Emotion: Absolute terror.
  • Sentence: 'We're out of milk.' Emotion: Euphoric victory. 'WE'RE OUT OF MILK!!!'

Tips

  • The more boring the sentence, the funnier the emotional delivery.
  • Suggestions for fun emotions: betrayed, falling in love, delivering a TED talk, delivering terrible news.
